recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not lower ImplementationGuide.fhirVersion to 0..* for this issue because FHIR-17777 intentionally superseded that part of the original request; handle future binding or extension-pack work under later applied/published issues.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking for multi-version IG support: repeatable ImplementationGuide.fhirVersion, ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.fhirVersion 0..*, an invariant limiting resource-level versions to IG-level versions, a StructureDefinition applicable-version extension, and multi-version usage/package guidance.
initial_application: The Jira-commented commit 6c82a7d4e4ffc589bd92ae82c9e2db27abafdbb4 only adjusted IG publisher ConfigFileConverter code in this history. Source history shows 08263bfe9f32a00a30072ebb06616df7e3797713 explicitly listing GF#18050 among breaking ImplementationGuide changes and adding multi-version IG narrative; later source refactors carried the behavior into source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-17777, resolved immediately after FHIR-18050, made ImplementationGuide.fhirVersion mandatory as 1..*, explaining why current source should not be changed back to the 0..* minimum in FHIR-18050. FHIR-39186 and FHIR-35168 are later published clarifications already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-55168 is a 2026 Resolved - change required binding follow-up and is outside this default Applied/Published source-edit scope. The applicable-version extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack and is referenced from core.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active ImplementationGuide source has ImplementationGuide.fhirVersion 1..*, ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.fhirVersion 0..*, the ig-2 invariant, multi-version IG narrative, different-version import guidance, and a link to the applicable-version extension.
